I. MYCOLOGY SPECIMEN COLLECTION
● For the diagnosis from skin and nails
● The ability of the laboratory to detect the fungus is very
much dependent on the quality of specimen it receives
A. SPECIMEN COLLECTION FOR DERMATOPHYTOSIS
● Dermatophytosis
→ It is the medical term used to describe fungal infections
of the skin hair and nails
COLLECTION INSTRUMENTS
❗ All instruments must be cleaned and sterilized after each
collection.
